name: Voxel Raytracer
definition: A voxel raytracer that renders 3D voxel models by marching rays through a 3D grid of voxels, supporting multiple bounces for diffuse reflection and a ground plane.
summary: A voxel raytracer renders 3D voxel models using full path-tracing with diffuse scattering and anti-aliasing, differing from standard raycasting by supporting multiple bounces.
